crossRefs.note: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,
from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.
Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.
The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.
Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
Deliver me, Yahweh, from the evil man. Preserve me from the violent man:
My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.

translations.web: Yahweh, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.
translations.bsb: Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble.
translations.kjv: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
translations.asv: Keep me, O Jehovah, from the hands of the wicked; Preserve me from the violent man: Who have purposed to thrust aside my steps.
